pipeline_steps.detail: Reddit, YouTube, Play/App Store, TradingQ&A, X, social manual
PII scrubbed, author_hash HMAC, zero usernames or handles
Haiku 5.5 message batch; relevance (r/a/n) and type (exp/q/adv)
Haiku 5.5 with H11 deterministic action rules and span grounding
Date-aware event timeline extraction for strict action validation
Deterministic consensus between main extraction and J1
Wilson 95% CIs on Kish effective sample sizes, within-source

corrections.title: Extraction prompt v1.3a rejected
corrections.detail: Tried on G1-dev and rejected (action identification 11/20 vs 15/20 in v1.2a). Replaced by deterministic H11 rule.

corrections.title: STOP C sample table transcription error
corrections.detail: Rows 5–10 were inadvertently typed rather than copied from JSON. Replaced with programmatic script copy and instituted Rule W8.

corrections.title: Groq-vs-Sonnet cross-model agreement
corrections.detail: Initial audit showed κ = 0 due to unmatched UID keys across test runs. Resolved with strict UID matching.

corrections.title: Publication date coverage backfill
corrections.detail: Export initially had posted='unknown' for main corpus due to add-on date rule mismatch; backfilled from UTC created_at (278 rows unparsable/unknown, 90,477 with posted YYYY-MM).

corrections.title: Theme codebook human agreement demotion
corrections.detail: Themes failed human agreement twice (κ 0.287 in G2, κ 0.357 in G3). Demoted from quantitative evidence to illustrative colour.

corrections.title: Findings check re-classifications
corrections.detail: The researcher's blind check flagged insurance premium as payment failure and KYC blocks as payment problems. Area A definition was updated accordingly.

corrections.title: Source rejections
corrections.detail: Quora answers rejected as advisor-dominated; LinkedIn comments rejected as B2B/advisor-heavy; Telegram broadcast channels rejected due to promotional spam.
